title: Merge Sorted Array
statement_short: Given two integer arrays sorted in non-decreasing order, merge the second array into the first array as a single sorted array in-place. The first array has additional empty space at the end to accommodate all elements.
hint: Small n and m do not restrict time complexity, but in-place merging requires O(1) extra space.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers iterating backward from the ends of both arrays merge elements in-place in O(m+n) time. Not Sorting: Concatenating and sorting takes O((m+n) log(m+n)) time. Not Heap / Priority Queue: Inserting all elements into a min-heap takes O((m+n) log(m+n)) time and extra space. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Hash tables do not preserve order and incur unnecessary space overhead.
